Job Title: Gen AI Engineer

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days/week)

Experience: 12 Years




About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic frameworks, and scalable backend systems, along with a strong foundation in software engineering and cloud technologies.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop GenAI-powered applications using LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise use cases
Develop and orchestrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems via APIs and microservices
Work on prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation of model outputs
Build scalable backend services using Python frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, Django)
Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Optimize performance, cost, and latency of AI systems



Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.)
Experience in building RAG pipelines and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, etc.)
Solid understanding of APIs, microservices architecture, and backend development
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and model evaluation
